title: Designing Reliable Business Workflows knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Designing Reliable Business Workflows”?
options: Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

Designing Reliable Business Workflows is about preserving a business invariant as data changes. MongoDB writes are atomic at the single-document level; workflows spanning documents may require conditional updates or transactions, plus clear retry and failure handling.
